remarks: IMMACULATE 2,990 sq. ft. END unit in complex of 26 townhouses located off a quiet cul-de-sac in Glenville. First floor features living room with fireplace, den with fireplace, a formal dining room large enough for holiday gatherings, powder room, and a sleek, high-end Bulthaup eat-in kitchen where function and designed will delight the chef in the home. 2nd floor offers a spacious primary bedroom suite with separate sitting room and dressing area, master bath. and a second bedroom with full bath. Walk-out lower level with radiant heat features a family room with gas fp, a 3rd bedroom, full bath and a large finished rec room with space for your gym, laundry w/sink, and hobby room. Whether relaxing on your deck, or barbecuing on your LL terrace, you will enjoy the privacy both spots offer.
